ownerIntent.globalRule: Establish the current Chi'llywood Sign In screen as the exact permanent visual source of truth for the whole user-facing application, extract its Chicago-night glass, typography, input, border, glow, spacing, and violet-to-electric-blue primary-action language into reusable canonical primitives, and migrate every appropriate current user-facing surface without changing behavior or authority.
ownerIntent.provisionalIntent: Admit one bounded presentation-only whole-app migration covering Auth and Recovery, legal acceptance, Home and every bottom tab, Settings, Chi'lly Circle, Chat, Profile, Library, Platform and Studio, Watch-Party, Live, Player-adjacent, creator, admin-facing, shared cards, controls, sheets, loading, empty, and error states while preserving the pre-edit behavioral contract baseline and treating any unintended functional delta as a P1 regression.

provisionalProofPlan.finalPhase1: ONE LIFECYCLE_AWARE CANONICAL RUN AT THE EXACT FROZEN HEAD
provisionalProofPlan.targetedMutantCoverage: ONE PER APPLICABLE VISUAL-SYSTEM OR BEHAVIOR-PRESERVATION INVARIANT

scopeWaiver.coherentObjective: One whole-app presentation-only migration to the exact existing Sign In-derived Chi'llywood visual system, with shared primitives and regression coverage preventing future visual drift.
scopeWaiver.reason: The Owner explicitly requires every appropriate user-facing route family and shared presentation primitive to converge in one permanent visual language; splitting the canonical token extraction from route-family adoption would preserve competing systems and make anti-drift enforcement internally inconsistent.

implementationPlan.cleanup: dismiss in-flight presentation overlays safely and preserve account-scoped authoritative state
